note: The departments a venture can import (EE-047). Each is one top-level category of APQC's cross-industry Process Classification Framework (version 7.x names), tagged with its place in Porter's value chain. A venture lists the ones it uses in venture.json `departments` and gets a folder for each only then (EE-048); each department's governance side (charter, policies, decision rights) sits under governance/departments/ and its operations side (work, assets, tools) under operations/departments/. The priors say how likely a venture needs the department in each phase, in need-now's format (EE-028); version 0.x, ours and unevaluated.

departments.label: Strategy
departments.governance: Strategic decisions and the link to the telos
departments.why: Until a team plans together, the purpose layer holds the venture's strategy

departments.label: Products and services

apqc.name: Develop and Manage Products and Services

departments.operations: Specs, roadmaps and the work of building (MAD, for software)
departments.why: The venture's offering; Porter files product development under technology development, a support activity, but for a venture whose product is its work it is primary

departments.label: Marketing and sales

apqc.name: Market and Sell Products and Services

departments.governance: Brand guidelines and the publication policy
departments.operations: The marketing website (EE-044), campaigns, marketing assets, the sales pipeline
departments.why: Validation needs an audience; the marketing website and outreach start here

departments.label: Supply chain

apqc.name: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products

departments.porter: inbound logistics, operations and outbound logistics
departments.why: Only for physical goods; the builder adds it when the venture makes or ships them

departments.label: Service delivery
departments.why: For ventures that sell a service

departments.label: Customer service
departments.operations: Support channels, help content, customer feedback

departments.label: Human capital (HR)
departments.governance: HR policies, the handbook, hiring decision rights
departments.why: With the first hire; agents alone are covered by the team plan

departments.label: Information technology
departments.why: A solo founder's tools live in the integrations list; IT becomes its own department with a team

departments.label: Finance and accounting
departments.why: Once money comes in or goes out, or the venture has a legal entity

departments.label: Assets and facilities
departments.why: Only with physical assets or premises

departments.label: Legal, risk and compliance

apqc.name: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency

departments.governance: Policies, the risk register, contract approval
departments.why: With a legal entity, customer data or contracts

departments.label: External relationships
departments.governance: Who may speak for the venture
departments.operations: Investor relations, partners, press and government affairs

departments.label: Business capabilities
departments.why: When processes are repeated by enough people to be worth improving
